svg.title: What I do
svg.desc: IT infrastructure engineer with seven years of experience in systems administration, cloud infrastructure, automation, and security.
svg.text: I started in 2019 on a helpdesk in Karachi. Dead laptops, forgotten passwords, a printer nobody
could fix. It taught me the thing I still work by: behind every ticket there is a person who cannot
Seven years and seven employers later the numbers are bigger. 265 government endpoints at KTDMC. 180
people across 12 countries at TestSolutions. Azure and AWS, Active Directory, firewalls, a few
hundred devices that all have to wake up working on Monday. The job never really changed. Keep it
running, keep it locked, make sure nobody has to think about it.
What I actually enjoy is deleting work. If something gets done by hand twice, I would rather lose a
week automating it than do it a third time — that is how 25 hours a week of manual onboarding and
patching disappeared at TestSolutions. The best compliment my work gets is silence: no outage, no
